$comment: The 500-line source file limit (#177), read by scripts/checks/file-size.mjs. limit: null (or a missing file) opts a repository out entirely — one note, zero failures. A line is counted as text.split('\n').length, minus one when the file ends in a trailing newline, which matches `wc -l` for every newline-terminated file and is stable across platforms because .gitattributes forces eol=lf. allowlist is a ratchet: a listed file's recorded 'lines' may only ever be lowered to match reality, never raised — growth beyond the recorded count fails, and so does an undocumented shrink, so the debt list can't go stale in either direction. Removing a path once it is under the limit is the definition of done for it.

exclude.why: fixtures — the document being validated is the point, not its length
